topAnswerPatterns.text: Use the stated direct answer or product-specific resolution.
Bond neutral and equipment grounding conductors only at service equipment and isolate them in subpanels.
The creator commits to producing or posting the requested instructional content in a future video.
Conventional current is opposite to electron drift, with electrons moving from negative to positive.
The neutral is the grounded reference and normal return conductor, while the hot is the ungrounded conductor; AC polarity reversal does not change those functional designations.
Match breaker protection to conductor ampacity: use 14 AWG on 15 A circuits and 12 AWG on 20 A circuits; do not determine ampacity from cable color.
Use the specified device or component as the direct solution.
Bond equipment grounding conductors to devices or metal enclosures with listed splices or grounding pigtails and verify continuity.
Use the stated material, tool, or accessory identified in the reply.
Hot conductors provide the alternating line potential relative to the grounded neutral.
Local code may require metallic conduit, including EMT, instead of cable for the application.
Marxman marking tool and purchase or demonstration link
Use the GFCI LINE terminals for separate GFCI devices unless downstream LOAD protection is intended.
Grounding or protective earthing provides a fault-current path so protective devices can disconnect the supply.
Install a local grounding electrode system at a separate building where required.
